artists.biography: Cody ChesnuTT, born 1968, is an American R&B and neo soul musician from Atlanta, Georgia. Chesnutt's music blends elements of rock, funk, soul, hip hop, and blues. After relocating to Los Angeles, Chesnutt found work with Death Row records, writing and producing five songs for the male R&B group Six Feet Deep. Chesnutt and his former band, The Crosswalk, had a brief stint with Hollywood Records in which they were later booted from the label. The band subsequently broke up and Chesnutt released a double LP in 2002 entitled The Headphone Masterpiece, which was recorded on a 4-track cassette recorder in his bedroom recording studio, which he calls "The Sonic Promiseland".

perplexity.description:
The Headphone Masterpiece is the debut album by American singer-songwriter and multi-instrumentalist Cody ChesnuTT, originally released in September 2002. Recorded entirely in his bedroom using a 4-track recorder, ChesnuTT performed nearly all instruments himself, blending elements of Electronic, Rock, and Funk/Soul into a raw, intimate sound. The album’s lo-fi production and genre-defying style—ranging from soulful ballads to experimental rock and electronic textures—reflect ChesnuTT’s eclectic influences and DIY approach. Its sprawling 36-song tracklist and double-album format showcase his ambitious songwriting and willingness to explore diverse musical territory.

As ChesnuTT’s first major release, The Headphone Masterpiece established him as a singular voice in alternative music, standing apart from mainstream trends of the early 2000s. Initially self-released before gaining wider distribution, the album was praised by critics for its adventurous spirit and emotional honesty, though some noted its indulgent length. It achieved modest commercial success, charting briefly on the Billboard 200 and selling over 25,000 copies by early 2003. The album’s original release on Ready Set Go! (not One Little Indian, which is unrelated to this release) marked the beginning of ChesnuTT’s career as an independent artist unafraid to challenge conventions.
